panel_exploration.original_harness:
import ast
import cProfile
import io
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from PIL import Image
from PySide6 import __version__ as pyside6_version
from PySide6.QtCore import QItemSelectionModel, QPersistentModelIndex, Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from je_file_tree.core.cleanup import CleanupGroup, DETAILS
from je_file_tree.core.coverage import Coverage
from je_file_tree.core.duplicates import DuplicateGroup, DuplicateResult, DuplicateSavings
from je_file_tree.core.formatting import format_size
from je_file_tree.core.node import Node
from je_file_tree.core.savings import Savings
from je_file_tree.core.similar_photos import SimilarPhotoGroup, SimilarPhotoResult
from je_file_tree.gui import cleanup_panel, duplicates_panel, i18n
from je_file_tree.gui.tree_model import NODE_ROLE

kind, action = sys.argv[1:3]
target_unit = next((arg.split('=', 1)[1] for arg in sys.argv if arg.startswith('--unit=')), 'B')
if '--legacy-defer' in sys.argv:
    from je_file_tree.gui import grouped_list
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QTreeView

    class DeferredView(QTreeView):
        def dataChanged(self, first, last, roles=()):
            if (self.uniformRowHeights() and first.parent() == last.parent()
                    and first.column() == last.column() == 1 and first.row() < last.row()
                    and list(roles) == [Qt.DisplayRole]):
                self.scheduleDelayedItemsLayout()
            super().dataChanged(first, last, roles)
    grouped_list.QTreeView = DeferredView
    grouped_list._LegacyGroupedView = DeferredView
if '--plain-view' in sys.argv:
    from je_file_tree.gui import grouped_list
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QTreeView
    grouped_list._LegacyGroupedView = QTreeView
if '--baseline' in sys.argv:
    for module, cls, filename, names in [
        (cleanup_panel, cleanup_panel.CleanupPanel, 'cleanup_panel', {'set_unit', 'retranslate', '_rebuild'}),
        (duplicates_panel, duplicates_panel.DuplicatesPanel, 'duplicates_panel', {'set_unit', 'retranslate', '_rebuild', '_rebuild_photos'}),
    ]:
        path = Path('build/' + filename + '_display_baseline.py')
        parsed = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        original = next(item for item in parsed.body if isinstance(item, ast.ClassDef) and item.name == cls.__name__)
        namespace = vars(module).copy()
        for method in original.body:
            if isinstance(method, ast.FunctionDef) and method.name in names:
                exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[method], type_ignores=[]), str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
                setattr(cls, method.name, namespace[method.name])
app = QApplication([])
i18n.set_language('en')
group_count, members = (1000, 100) if kind == 'exact' else ((3, 33334) if kind == 'cleanup' else (2, 600))
root = Node('captured-display-probe', True, children=[])
groups = [[Node(f'{group}-{row:07}', False, size=1536, modified=(row * 997) % members, parent=root)
           for row in range(members)] for group in range(group_count)]
root.children.extend(node for group in groups for node in group)
source = tuple(root.children)
panel = cleanup_panel.CleanupPanel() if kind == 'cleanup' else duplicates_panel.DuplicatesPanel()
panel._root = root
if kind == 'cleanup':
    keys = ['browser_cache', 'thumbnails', 'temp']
    panel._groups = [CleanupGroup(key, files, 1536 * len(files), DETAILS[key]) for key, files in zip(keys, groups, strict=True)]
    panel._coverage = Coverage(1536 * len(source), 1, 0, 0, 0, frozenset())
elif kind == 'exact':
    panel._groups = [DuplicateGroup(1536, files, kept=files[0]) for files in groups]
    panel._found = DuplicateResult(list(panel.groups), len(source), len(source) * 1536, 0)
    value = Savings(1536 * (members - 1), 4096, 0, 4096, 1000, False)
    panel._savings = DuplicateSavings(value, [value] * group_count, [None] * group_count)
else:
    panel.kind.setCurrentIndex(panel.kind.findData('photos'))
    panel._root = root
    thumbnail = io.BytesIO()
    Image.new('RGB', (8, 8), 'red').save(thumbnail, format='PNG')
    panel._photos = SimilarPhotoResult([SimilarPhotoGroup(files, [0] * len(files)) for files in groups],
                                      len(source), 0, 4, {node: thumbnail.getvalue() for node in source[:1000]})
panel._rebuild()
if kind != 'cleanup':
    panel._update()
panel.setAttribute(Qt.WA_DontShowOnScreen)
panel.resize(1000, 600)
panel.show()
app.processEvents()
parent = panel.model.index(panel.model.rowCount() - 1, 0)
last = panel.model.rowCount(parent) - 1
current = panel.model.index(last, 2, parent)
chosen = current.data(NODE_ROLE)
selection = panel.view.selectionModel()
selection.setCurrentIndex(current, QItemSelectionModel.ClearAndSelect | QItemSelectionModel.Rows)
pinned = QPersistentModelIndex(current)
captured = [group.nodes for group in panel.model._groups]
icon = panel.model.index(last, 0, parent).data(Qt.DecorationRole)
panel.view.collapse(panel.model.index(0, 0))
panel.view.setColumnWidth(0, 317)
panel.view.scrollTo(current)
if '--threshold-zero' in sys.argv:
    panel.view.setUpdateThreshold(0)
if '--default-threshold' in sys.argv:
    panel.view.setUpdateThreshold(200)
app.processEvents()
scroll = panel.view.verticalScrollBar().value()
resets = []
panel.model.modelReset.connect(lambda: resets.append(True))
profile = cProfile.Profile() if '--profile' in sys.argv else None
if profile:
    profile.enable()
started = time.perf_counter()
if action == 'unit':
    panel.set_unit(target_unit)
else:
    i18n.set_language('zh-TW')
    panel.retranslate()
update_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
app.processEvents()
settled_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
if profile:
    profile.disable()
    profile.dump_stats('build/grouped-display-' + kind + '-' + action + '-' + ('before' if '--baseline' in sys.argv else 'after') + '.prof')
parent = panel.model.index(panel.model.rowCount() - 1, 0)
assert tuple(root.children) == source
assert panel.model.index(last, 1, parent).data() == format_size(1536, panel.unit)
assert panel.model.headerData(0, Qt.Horizontal) == i18n.tr('column_name')
assert all(panel.model.rowCount(panel.model.index(row, 0)) == len(nodes) for row, nodes in enumerate(captured))
print(json.dumps({'variant': 'before' if '--baseline' in sys.argv else 'after', 'profiled': bool(profile),
                  'threshold_zero_override': '--threshold-zero' in sys.argv,
                  'legacy_defer_override': '--legacy-defer' in sys.argv,
                  'plain_view_override': '--plain-view' in sys.argv,
                  'default_threshold_override': '--default-threshold' in sys.argv,
                  'pyside6': pyside6_version, 'view_class': type(panel.view).__name__,
                  'target_unit': target_unit if action == 'unit' else None,
                  'update_threshold': panel.view.updateThreshold() if hasattr(panel.view, 'updateThreshold') else None,
                  'kind': kind, 'action': action, 'platform': app.platformName(),
                  'groups': len(captured), 'members': sum(len(nodes) for nodes in captured),
                  'source_members': len(source), 'update_ms': round(update_ms, 2), 'settled_ms': round(settled_ms, 2),
                  'resets': len(resets), 'selected_node_preserved': [i.data(NODE_ROLE) for i in selection.selectedRows()] == [chosen],
                  'current_preserved': pinned.isValid() and selection.currentIndex() == pinned,
                  'scroll_preserved_within_limits': panel.view.verticalScrollBar().value() == min(scroll, panel.view.verticalScrollBar().maximum()),
                  'scroll_before': scroll, 'scroll_after': panel.view.verticalScrollBar().value(),
                  'scroll_max_after': panel.view.verticalScrollBar().maximum(),
                  'width_preserved': panel.view.columnWidth(0) == 317,
                  'first_collapsed': not panel.view.isExpanded(panel.model.index(0, 0)),
                  'member_tuples_preserved': all(group.nodes is nodes for group, nodes in zip(panel.model._groups, captured, strict=True)),
                  'thumbnail_identity_preserved': kind != 'photos' or panel.model.index(last, 0, parent).data(Qt.DecorationRole).cacheKey() == icon.cacheKey(),
                  'source_unchanged': True, 'all_rows_present': True, 'requested_size_and_column_header_current': True}), flush=True)
panel.view.setModel(None)
panel.close()

native_path: Qt 6.8 QAbstractItemView connects model headerDataChanged to its private headerDataChanged, which calls doDelayedItemsLayout. QTreeView.doItemsLayout clears and rebuilds viewItems, invokes the ordinary header layout and queues its accessibility update. Header-only measurements independently reproduce wide work on the two observed runtimes. Native handlers/notifications remain unchanged; this does not establish the owner hanging path.
